categories.main_business_segments: Biwin Storage Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, packaging, testing, production, and sales of semiconductor memory products and advanced packaging and testing services. Its product lines include embedded storage, PC storage, industrial and automotive-grade storage, enterprise-level storage, mobile storage, and advanced packaging services. The company serves diverse markets such as mobile smart terminals, PCs, industry terminals, data centers, smart automobiles, and mobile storage devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced semiconductor storage technologies including NAND Flash and DRAM chips, with capabilities in chip design, firmware algorithms, advanced packaging (including 16-layer stacking, ultra-thin die, multi-chip heterogeneous integration), and chip testing equipment development. It has developed proprietary main control chips (e.g., SP1800 for eMMC), advanced wafer-level packaging technologies (e.g., Fanout Memory Stack, Computing Memory Chiplet), and comprehensive testing systems covering ATE, Burn-in, and SLT tests. The company also focuses on wafer-level advanced packaging to integrate storage and computing chips, supporting AI and edge computing applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global smartphone manufacturers (OPPO, Motorola, Xiaomi), PC brands (Lenovo, HP, Acer), AI/AR smart glasses companies (Meta, Google, Rokid), automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, and enterprise data center clients such as China Mobile. The company serves markets spanning mobile devices, PCs, servers, smart wearables, industrial and automotive sectors, and emerging AI edge devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: Biwin operates primarily in China with headquarters in Shenzhen and manufacturing bases in Huizhou and other cities. It has established subsidiaries and sales networks in Hong Kong, the United States, Brazil, and other regions. The company’s products are sold globally, covering over 39 countries and regions with local offices or distributor networks in 17 countries including the US and Brazil.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the semiconductor storage supply chain. It procures NAND Flash and DRAM wafers and chips from leading global manufacturers, designs and develops storage solutions and main control chips, and performs advanced packaging, testing, and module manufacturing. It provides integrated storage solutions and advanced packaging services to OEMs and brand customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Biwin’s strategic focus includes expanding its presence in five core markets (mobile phones, PCs, servers, smart wearables, industrial/automotive storage), developing chip design capabilities (notably main control chips for eMMC and UFS), and building wafer-level advanced packaging capacity. The company invests heavily in R&D for storage solutions, chip design, advanced packaging, and testing equipment, aiming to lead in AI-driven storage technologies and integrated storage-computing packaging. It also explores new interfaces, storage media, and innovative testing technologies.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of semiconductor storage devices (embedded storage, SSDs, memory modules, storage cards) and advanced packaging and testing services. Sales are conducted via direct sales to OEMs and brand customers, as well as through authorized brand operations and distribution channels globally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Biwin is positioned as a leading domestic storage solution provider with a comprehensive product portfolio and integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities. It competes with global storage giants by focusing on advanced packaging and AI edge storage solutions. The company has secured supply relationships with top-tier customers and is recognized for its innovation in embedded storage and advanced packaging, distinguishing itself with proprietary chip design and wafer-level packaging technologies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Biwin achieved revenue of approximately RMB 6.7 billion, an 86.46% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 161 million, a 125.82% increase. The company’s total assets reached RMB 7.96 billion, growing 25.72%, with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 2.41 billion, up 25.08%. R&D investment was RMB 447 million, up 78.99%, reflecting strong growth and expansion in scale and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Biwin emphasizes its integrated storage and advanced packaging capabilities, offering differentiated high-performance, low-power, compact storage solutions tailored for AI, mobile, PC, automotive, and industrial applications. Its proprietary main control chips, advanced firmware algorithms, and wafer-level packaging technologies provide customers with superior product performance, reliability, and customization. The company’s comprehensive R&D and manufacturing integration enables rapid innovation and quality assurance, creating significant competitive advantages in emerging AI and edge computing markets.
